remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Sold to George Herbert Engelhard. Now owned by his daughter, Georgia Engelhard. Stored at An American Place." Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks record as oil. Whitney Archive does not record medium. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A softly rendered, red and pink apple, seen from above, sits on piece of white fabric or paper. Below the white material, a reddish-brown surface is visible.
